title: Earnings Debit Reserve on Closing Cartwise Shopper Payouts Accounts — Training Notes
content:
### Training notes: the closing debit reserve (Cartwise Shopper Payouts)

**The rule.** When a Cartwise Shopper Payouts account closes, a closing debit reserve is held back from the final disbursement for 30 days: 25.00 for 3 or more earnings debits in the last 3 months, 12.50 for 1 or 2, and nothing for none.

**Q. What counts as an earnings debit?**
A. An earnings debit is an entry on the payout account that takes a batch tip reduction or a batch pay reversal out of the unpaid earnings balance. Each such entry counts once.

**Q. Which debits fall in "the last 3 months"?**
A. The last 3 months counts the earnings debits booked fewer than 3 whole months before the day of the closing. A debit booked exactly 3 whole months before the closing day, or earlier, is not counted.

**Q. Does the size of the debits matter?**
A. No. The reserve turns on how many earnings debits there are, not on their amounts.

**Q. Where are the band edges?**
A. Two debits still fall in the 12.50 band; the third debit moves the account to the 25.00 band. With no debit in the window there is no closing debit reserve.

| Earnings debits, last 3 months | Closing debit reserve |
|---|---|
| 0 | None |
| 1 | 12.50 |
| 2 | 12.50 |
| 3 or more | 25.00 |

**Hypothetical example.** An account shows earnings debits booked 10 days, 7 weeks and 4 months before the closing day. The first two fall in the last 3 months and the third does not, so the count is 2 and the closing debit reserve is 12.50.
